summary: Iteration 44 — Full E2E pass. OrdersPanel.js item row (line 210) uses bold <b className='font-medium'> wrapping product_name/name, and conditionally hides the 'Rs.subtotal' suffix when item.price === 0 — meets spec exactly.
InventoryManagerDashboard order-detail dialog renders 11 preset badge chips + a Custom-tag <Input> + Add button + click-to-remove on applied tags — visually verified.
